record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: Find Banach spaces that contain an unconditional basic sequence and nevertheless have few approximable operators in the sense that app(X) is strictly smaller than c0*(N).

evidence.quote: A Banach space X is said to have few approximable operators whenever app(X) is strictly smaller than c*_0(N).
Problem 22. Find Banach spaces with an unconditional basic sequence that have few approximable operators.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be an infinite-dimensional Banach space. Denote by $\mathfrak{L}(X)$ the Banach algebra of all bounded linear operators on $X$, and by $\mathfrak{App}(X)$ the closed two-sided ideal of approximable operators, i.e. the closure (in the operator norm) of the ideal of finite-rank operators on $X$. 

Let $c_0^*(\mathbb{N})$ denote the operator ideal consisting of all bounded linear operators $T \in \mathfrak{L}(X)$ such that for every bounded sequence $(x_n)$ in $X$ and every bounded sequence $(x_n^*)$ in $X^*$, the sequence $(\langle Tx_n, x_n^*\rangle)$ tends to $0$; equivalently, the component on $X$ of the operator ideal of all operators which factor through (or are uniformly approximable by) $c_0$-type evaluations.

Say that $X$ has "few approximable operators" if 
$$\mathfrak{App}(X) \subsetneq c_0^*(\mathbb{N})(X),$$
i.e. the inclusion is strict.

Problem. Construct (or prove the existence of) an infinite-dimensional Banach space $X$ such that:
(i) $X$ contains an unconditional basic sequence, and
(ii) $X$ has few approximable operators in the above sense.
artifact.status_search_result: Existing constructions of Banach spaces with "few operators" (e.g. Gowers–Maurey-type spaces and Argyros's sequentially unconditional space) are designed precisely to avoid unconditional basic sequences, or have unconditionality only sequentially. No construction was found combining the presence of an unconditional basic sequence with the strict inclusion App(X) ⊊ c_0^*(N). The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: A Sequentially Unconditional Banach Space with Few Operators (Argyros)
status_evidence.snippet: A reflexive sequentially unconditional Banach space exists where every bounded linear operator is a strictly singular perturbation of a multiple of the identity.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related constructions exist with sequential unconditionality and few operators, but not with an actual unconditional basic sequence.

status_evidence.title: Banach Spaces with Few Operators (handbook chapter)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of constructions of Banach spaces with few operators, all relying on the absence of unconditional basic sequences.
status_evidence.claim: Standard 'few operators' constructions rely on absence of unconditional basic sequences.

status_evidence.title: The unconditional basic sequence problem (Gowers–Maurey)
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of HI spaces with no unconditional basic sequence.
status_evidence.claim: The known few-operators spaces are HI / lack unconditional basic sequences.
